scripts/benchmark_hydration_rpc.py show two stable tiers - fast
~100-250ms, slow ~800-1250ms - but the ordering *within* the fast tier
is run-to-run noise, so treat the fast six as interchangeable rather
than as a ranking. Re-measure with the benchmark script before
reordering. Note rpc.hydradx.cloud, the official Galactic Council node
most lists recommend, measured slowest of the ten.
